label: Q8_0 fused gate+up MMVQ — same t128 + VDR=2 combo, default-on
rationale: C9-followup proved t128 + VDR=2 wins on Q8_0 single-row (+3 % on both 27B-Q8_0 variants). Same lever should compose with the fused gate+up kernel — gate/up share the activation read in HBM, so they amortize the same way as single-row dispatch.
wiring: qmatmul.rs `mmvq_q8_0_gate_up()` wrapper now picks `mmvq_q8_0_gate_up_t128_vdr2` by default, with `FLAMBEAU_Q8_0_GU_T128_VDR2=off` to opt back to the 256t baseline. No additional dispatch row needed — the wrapper switches kernels in-place.

decision.rationale: Stacks cleanly with C9-followup. Cumulative 27B-Q8_0 decode +6-7 % vs the pre-cycle baseline. Bit-exact decode trajectory preserved on Qwen3.5-27B-Q8_0 (last_id=7 matches across all four configs). Qwen3.6-27B-Q8_0 last_id flips (3 vs 313) but warm_argmax=11 matches — F32 reduce-order noise propagating through 64 decode steps, not a correctness bug.
